briefing.title: New training — briefing
briefing.intro: Four inputs determine scope, tone, and production cost. The agent researches your Cortex before writing anything.
briefing.topicHint: What is it about, and what should learners be able to do afterwards?
briefing.audienceHint: e.g. new employees, coaching clients, 10th grade — beginners or advanced?
briefing.materialHint: Script, course concept, policy, bullet points — the agent builds on it instead of reinventing.

production.title: Production
production.startHint: Starts media production. Video generation and similar steps incur comparatively high costs.
production.pickRef: Pick the guide character reference image — it anchors the look of all videos. Choose the candidate WITHOUT baked-in text.
production.confirmVideoHint: Quoted cost for all video shots:
production.resumeHint: Resumes production at the failed step — completed steps are skipped.
production.downloadHint: A single offline-capable HTML file — runs on double-click, shareable via mail/Drive/LMS.
briefing.visualStyleHint: Applies to all AI videos and images. Explainer animations are unaffected.
